```{r}
library(GEOquery)
library(dplyr)
library(sva)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(matrixStats)
library(randomForest)
library(caret)

GSE15852 <- getGEO(filename = "~/Desktop/DATA3888/Group Project/Breast Cancer/GSE15852_series_matrix.txt.gz")
GSE9574  <- getGEO(filename = "~/Desktop/DATA3888/Group Project/Breast Cancer/GSE9574_series_matrix.txt.gz")
GSE29431 <- getGEO(filename = "~/Desktop/DATA3888/Group Project/Breast Cancer/GSE29431_series_matrix.txt.gz")
```
```{r}
metadata_GSE15852 <- pData(GSE15852)
metadata_GSE9574  <- pData(GSE9574)
metadata_GSE29431 <- pData(GSE29431)

dim(metadata_GSE15852)
dim(metadata_GSE9574)
dim(metadata_GSE29431)

colnames(metadata_GSE15852)
colnames(metadata_GSE9574)
colnames(metadata_GSE29431)
```

```{r}
head(metadata_GSE15852[, 1:min(6, ncol(metadata_GSE15852))])
head(metadata_GSE9574[, 1:min(6, ncol(metadata_GSE9574))])
head(metadata_GSE29431[, 1:min(6, ncol(metadata_GSE29431))])
```

```{r}
metadata_GSE15852 <- metadata_GSE15852 %>%
  mutate(Status = case_when(
    source_name_ch1 == "normal breast tissue" ~ "control",
    TRUE ~ "tumor"
  ))

metadata_GSE9574 <- metadata_GSE9574 %>%
  mutate(Status = case_when(
    characteristics_ch1 == "disease-state: normal (reduction mammoplasty)" ~ "control",
    TRUE ~ "tumor"
  ))

metadata_GSE29431 <- metadata_GSE29431 %>%
  mutate(Status = case_when(
    grepl("^Normal", title, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "control",
    TRUE ~ "tumor"
  ))
```

```{r}
table(metadata_GSE15852$Status)
table(metadata_GSE9574$Status)
table(metadata_GSE29431$Status)

head(metadata_GSE15852[, c("source_name_ch1", "Status")])
head(metadata_GSE9574[, c("characteristics_ch1", "Status")])
head(metadata_GSE29431[, c("title", "Status")])
```

```{r}
metadata_list <- list(
  GSE15852 = metadata_GSE15852,
  GSE9574  = metadata_GSE9574,
  GSE29431 = metadata_GSE29431
)

cleaned_metadata_list <- lapply(names(metadata_list), function(x) {
  metadata_list[[x]] %>%
    filter(Status %in% c("control", "tumor")) %>%
    mutate(Study = x, SampleID = rownames(.)) %>%
    select(SampleID, Status, Study)
})

master_metadata <- bind_rows(cleaned_metadata_list)
rownames(master_metadata) <- master_metadata$SampleID
```

```{r}
table(master_metadata$Study)
table(master_metadata$Status)

head(master_metadata)
```

Step 6: Extract expression matrix
```{r}
exp_list <- list(
  GSE15852 = exprs(GSE15852),
  GSE9574  = exprs(GSE9574),
  GSE29431 = exprs(GSE29431)
)
```

```{r}
lapply(exp_list, dim)
```
```{r}
rownames(exp_list$GSE15852)[1:5]
colnames(exp_list$GSE15852)[1:5]

rownames(exp_list$GSE9574)[1:5]
colnames(exp_list$GSE9574)[1:5]

rownames(exp_list$GSE29431)[1:5]
colnames(exp_list$GSE29431)[1:5]
```
Step 7: Check and utilise
```{r}
check_and_log_fixed <- function(gse_obj) {
  ex <- exprs(gse_obj)
  
  if (max(ex, na.rm = TRUE) > 50) {
    message("Log-transforming raw data with flooring...")
    ex[ex <= 0] <- 1
    exprs(gse_obj) <- log2(ex)
  } else {
    message("Data is already log-scaled.")
  }
  return(gse_obj)
}

GSE15852 <- check_and_log_fixed(GSE15852)
GSE9574  <- check_and_log_fixed(GSE9574)
GSE29431 <- check_and_log_fixed(GSE29431)
```

```{r}
exp_list <- list(
  GSE15852 = exprs(GSE15852),
  GSE9574  = exprs(GSE9574),
  GSE29431 = exprs(GSE29431)
)
```

```{r}
sapply(exp_list, function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
```

Step 8: metadata parallel
```{r}
exp_filtered <- lapply(names(exp_list), function(x) {
  samples_to_keep <- master_metadata$SampleID[master_metadata$Study == x]
  exp_list[[x]][, samples_to_keep, drop = FALSE]
})

names(exp_filtered) <- names(exp_list)
```

```{r}
lapply(exp_filtered, dim)
```

```{r}
all(colnames(exp_filtered$GSE15852) %in% master_metadata$SampleID)
all(colnames(exp_filtered$GSE9574) %in% master_metadata$SampleID)
all(colnames(exp_filtered$GSE29431) %in% master_metadata$SampleID)
```

Step 9: find probes and merge
```{r}
common_probes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(exp_filtered, rownames))
length(common_probes)
```

```{r}
merged_expression <- do.call(cbind, lapply(exp_filtered, function(x) x[common_probes, ]))
dim(merged_expression)
```

```{r}
merged_expression[1:min(5, nrow(merged_expression)), 1:min(5, ncol(merged_expression))]
```

```{r}
all(colnames(merged_expression) %in% master_metadata$SampleID)
head(colnames(merged_expression))
head(master_metadata$SampleID)
```

Step 10: Previous Combat PCA
```{r}
pca_before <- prcomp(t(merged_expression), scale. = TRUE)

pca_before_df <- data.frame(
  SampleID = rownames(pca_before$x),
  PC1 = pca_before$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_before$x[, 2]
) %>%
  left_join(master_metadata, by = "SampleID")

var_explained_before <- round(100 * pca_before$sdev^2 / sum(pca_before$sdev^2), 1)
```

```{r}
ggplot(pca_before_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Study, shape = Status)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA Before ComBat",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained_before[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained_before[2], "%)")
  )
```

Step 11: ComBat batch correction
```{r}
library(sva)

mod <- model.matrix(~ as.factor(Status), data = master_metadata)

final_expression_clean <- ComBat(
  dat = merged_expression,
  batch = master_metadata$Study,
  mod = mod,
  par.prior = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
dim(final_expression_clean)
```

Step 12: After ComBat PCA
```{r}
pca_after <- prcomp(t(final_expression_clean), scale. = TRUE)

pca_after_df <- data.frame(
  SampleID = rownames(pca_after$x),
  PC1 = pca_after$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_after$x[, 2]
) %>%
  left_join(master_metadata, by = "SampleID")

var_explained_after <- round(100 * pca_after$sdev^2 / sum(pca_after$sdev^2), 1)
```

```{r}
ggplot(pca_after_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Study, shape = Status)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA After ComBat",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained_after[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained_after[2], "%)")
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(pca_after_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Status, shape = Study)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA After ComBat (colored by Status)",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained_after[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained_after[2], "%)")
  )
```

Step 13: Heatmap
```{r}
ordered_indices <- order(master_metadata$Status)
metadata_sorted <- master_metadata[ordered_indices, ]
expression_sorted <- final_expression_clean[, ordered_indices]

library(matrixStats)
rv <- rowVars(expression_sorted)
idx <- order(rv, decreasing = TRUE)[1:50]

pheatmap(expression_sorted[idx, ],
         annotation_col = metadata_sorted[, c("Status", "Study"), drop = FALSE],
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         main = "Top 50 Variable Genes",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
         scale = "row")
```

Step 14: Modelling
```{r}
library(randomForest)
library(caret)

X <- t(final_expression_clean)
y <- as.factor(master_metadata$Status)


set.seed(123)
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(y, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

X_train <- X[trainIndex, ]
y_train <- y[trainIndex]
X_test  <- X[-trainIndex, ]
y_test  <- y[-trainIndex]


table(y_train)


min_class <- min(table(y_train))

rf_model <- randomForest(
  x = X_train,
  y = y_train,
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE,
  sampsize = c(min_class, min_class)
)


predictions <- predict(rf_model, X_test)


conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(predictions, y_test)
print(conf_matrix)
```
